finding.headline: "The Edges-Gone Relaxed-Hair Mum"
finding.problem: "My hair is coming out in clumps. My edges are gone. I'm scared to touch it. I used to be the one with the long relaxed hair — now I wear a scarf everywhere and people think I'm sick."
finding.person: 30-yr-old Nigerian mum, relaxed hair, 4 months postpartum; took down braids to find thinning edges + handfuls shedding.
finding.competition_notes: See RESEARCH BASE section of source report.

disposition.rationale: Report assigns: "Standalone → "Postpartum Hair Rescue for African Hair: Stop the Shed, Save Your Edges"". Verdict: PASSES (5/5) —.
